capabilities.physics: Lossless surface PEC in vacuum, optional infinite horizontal PEC ground
capabilities.postFileExports: Configured source/field files are listed in the stage receipt; no automatic host artifact/UI routes are declared for them.
capabilities.stageReceipts: v1, best effort; integrity state remains mandatory

breakingChanges.note: API 2 replaces API 1 model.state text/loose matrix outputs with direct public extract/model.peec. New production writes no bin/txt artifacts, including private/staging files. Standard SAVE_BIN/SAVE_TXT are rejected by presence; legacy controls warn as deprecated. Geometry/topology are in the package; source snapshots, model/stage states and standard context are structured JSON.

Compact_EM identity with the FreeSpace PEC/vacuum implementation. API 4 replaces legacy Compact PEECPK01/schema1 with FreeSpace PEECFS02/version2 and model schema2. Re-extract models; old Compact model files are not binary compatible. Provider output/log/receipt identity is compact_em. The S CSV reference remains compact_em/sp.csv; Y/Z are optional additions. Existing FreeSpace stderr behavior is declared as errorContract none.

Same-version revision requested by the user: retain Compact_EM v1.4/API4. Post outputs are Source.msh and Field.msh with _real/_imag/_mag views. Split paths are no longer produced; use revisionId and package SHA-256 to identify this output arrangement. Numerical code, executable bytes, model PEECFS02/version2 and public model/S/Y/Z artifacts are unchanged.

API 5 declares qs-json-stderr for extract/solve/post. MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC B5 and C4 conflict on this transition; this release follows B5 and increments the API. Software version uses x.y.z; the release batch is separate. Model PEECFS02/version2, data layout 1.6, supported physics and successful artifact routes retain their contracts. Invalid post frequency/port selections are rejected instead of silently clamped.

Public compute entry points require explicit --data-root and only Setting/set_em.json plus Model/source_em.json for settings/source definitions. Deprecated set.txt/set.json/root SET_EM.json and port.json/port_em.json names are rejected even when canonical files coexist, using QS-FMT-INPUT-LEGACY_NAME_REJECTED before business outputs or stage markers change. Required model_em.msh/matdb.json inputs and PEECFS02/version2 remain unchanged. This intentionally ends the set.txt transition by user instruction dated2026-11-13. API increments because the previously optional data-root entry is now required (B1).

API7/B4: public flat settings use schema2 only; schema1 no longer incorrectly describes the FreeSpace field set. Unknown optional keys are ignored; known unsupported physics/output/CLI keys reject. Private modular format remains schema1. All three stages acquire .locks/compact_em.run.lock before business writes; busy returns QS-COMM-MODULE-BUSY/exit1; stale files are reusable and OS locks release on termination. Implicit Touchstone writes are removed. DLL and canonical input-name policies remain unchanged.
